package.name: easyfleet_easynav_navigation
package.description: Real navigation capability implementation, backed by the EasyNav navigation stack (easynav_system::GoalManagerClient) and structured as a BehaviorTree.CPP tree (StartOff, Navigate, Finish). Resolves the named waypoints configured as ROS parameters to poses before handing them to EasyNav -- EasyNav itself has no named-waypoint concept. The reference example of a real easyfleet_core::NavigationActionServerBase backend (the "fake" one in easyfleet_example_deployments is a mock; this one drives a real EasyNav system).
